name: tint
description: Tints the desktop app's backdrop by project and branch: a calm hue of its own for each repository, a warning glow on main, release branches and production folders

riskyBranches.title: Warning branches
riskyBranches.description: Globs of branch names that get the warning tint (* is any run of characters)

defaultBranch.title: Warn on the default branch
defaultBranch.description: The repository's default branch gets the warning tint whatever its name

riskyPaths.title: Warning folders
riskyPaths.description: Globs of folder names; a working copy under one gets the warning tint
